watch.topic: EU AI Act implementation material affecting the private deployment readiness checklist
questions: Which approved public changes require the Governance Review Team to review the deployment readiness checklist?
Which published changes are corrected, withdrawn, contradictory, or still uncertain against the July baseline?

queries.query: EU AI Act implementation guidance and correction notices
EU AI Act implementation FAQ withdrawal notices
EU AI Act deployment implementation notice

conditions: A primary authority changes, corrects, withdraws, or contradicts a checklist-relevant implementation statement.
The source preserves baseline context without a checklist-relevant change.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
sources.scope: Primary legal-text baseline retained for identity and chronological context.

sources.title: Representative AI Office implementation guidance baseline
sources.scope: Fixture-only official guidance baseline; preserve source identity rather than reproduce restricted or changing page text.

sources.title: Representative AI Office implementation guidance update
sources.scope: Fixture-only current official guidance version that supersedes the July baseline record.

sources.title: Representative AI Office guidance correction notice
sources.scope: Fixture-only correction lineage; the owner must review the controlling public record before changing a checklist.

sources.title: Representative AI Office implementation FAQ baseline
sources.scope: Fixture-only FAQ baseline retained so that its withdrawal remains visible in the delta ledger.

sources.title: Representative AI Office FAQ withdrawal notice
sources.scope: Fixture-only withdrawal lineage; the prior FAQ cannot silently remain current support.

sources.title: Representative European Commission implementation notice
sources.scope: Fixture-only approved public notice requiring owner review for applicability to the private deployment checklist.

observations.summary: The baseline legal-text identity remains retained without a newly classified change in this run.

claims.statement: The authoritative legal-text record remains a retained baseline reference for the topic watch.
claims.uncertainty: The artifact records source identity and timing, not a legal interpretation.

observations.uncertainty: The owner retains any legal interpretation or operational decision.

topicRelevance.rationale: The legal text defines the named implementation topic.

decisionRelevance.rationale: No independently classified change was found for this retained baseline identity.

priority.rationale: The record provides baseline context rather than a new checklist trigger.

observations.summary: The approved guidance record has a superseding update and a linked correction that require owner review before any checklist change.

claims.statement: An approved public guidance record supersedes the retained July source version.
claims.uncertainty: The delta does not determine whether the changed record applies to a particular deployment.

claims.statement: A linked correction notice qualifies the current guidance record pending owner review.
claims.uncertainty: The controlling wording and operational relevance require the private owner review.

observations.uncertainty: A source correction is not an autonomous instruction to alter deployment controls.

topicRelevance.rationale: The source is an approved implementation-guidance authority for the declared topic.

decisionRelevance.rationale: A corrected implementation record may require the owner to review the checklist.

priority.rationale: The source both supersedes and corrects a baseline implementation record.

observations.summary: The FAQ baseline record has a linked withdrawal notice and remains only as historical lineage.

claims.statement: The withdrawal notice removes the retained FAQ from current support until an owner reviews a replacement source.
claims.uncertainty: The ledger does not infer why the FAQ was withdrawn or which replacement guidance controls.

observations.uncertainty: Withdrawal lineage identifies a review need but does not supply replacement implementation guidance.

topicRelevance.rationale: The withdrawn FAQ was part of the approved implementation baseline.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The owner must decide whether any private checklist reference depended on the withdrawn record.

priority.rationale: A baseline implementation source was withdrawn.

observations.summary: A new approved public implementation notice is retained for private applicability and contradiction review.

claims.statement: The approved public notice is new to this run and must be assessed against the private deployment checklist.
claims.uncertainty: The notice may use a different implementation framing; the ledger does not resolve applicability.

observations.uncertainty: A new public notice does not establish consensus, causality, or an implementation decision.

topicRelevance.rationale: The source is an approved authority for official implementation notices.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The owner must decide whether the new notice changes the review agenda or checklist.

priority.rationale: The notice is a new approved source with possible checklist relevance.

deltas.summary: A new approved public implementation notice is retained for owner review, not as an autonomous checklist change.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The owner must assess applicability to the declared private decision area.

deltas.summary: The current guidance record explicitly supersedes the July baseline source version.

decisionRelevance.rationale: A superseding source must be reviewed before the owner changes the checklist.

deltas.summary: A linked correction qualifies the superseding guidance record and takes precedence over the earlier changed classification.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The correction needs accountable review before any conclusion about checklist impact.

deltas.summary: The withdrawal notice keeps the historical FAQ visible while preventing it from silently supporting a current claim.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The owner must review whether the private baseline cited the withdrawn FAQ.

deltas.summary: The two approved records may frame implementation differently; the relationship remains a question for owner review rather than a resolved conclusion.

decisionRelevance.rationale: The owner must compare scope and applicability before treating either record as a checklist instruction.

deltas.summary: The baseline legal-text identity remains visible without a newly classified change in this run.

decisionRelevance.rationale: This retained identity adds no independently classified decision change.

reviewQueue.question: Does the superseding and corrected guidance alter any private deployment checklist reference?
reviewQueue.resolution: The owner will compare the controlling public record in the next private review; this ledger does not alter the checklist.

reviewQueue.question: Which private notes, if any, retained the withdrawn FAQ as current support?
reviewQueue.resolution: Retain the FAQ only as withdrawal lineage and queue a replacement-source review with the owner.

reviewQueue.question: Are the new notice and corrected guidance applicable to the same deployment scope?
reviewQueue.resolution: Keep both records visible for the owner; no consensus, causal inference, or decision change is made by the monitor.

gapsAndBlockers.description: The ledger cannot determine whether the new public notice applies to the team's private deployment scope.

consensus.rationale: The ledger records individually sourced public changes and questions; it does not infer consensus.

causalInference.rationale: Source change timing does not establish a causal effect on deployment or compliance outcomes.

synthesis.summary: The private ledger preserves one new notice, a superseding and corrected guidance record, a withdrawn FAQ, a possible contradiction, and an unchanged legal-text identity for accountable review.
